newsitem.title: MACAU: Taiwan extradites jetfoil robbery suspect to Macau.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan extradites jetfoil robbery suspect to Macau.

text.p: Taiwan has extradited to Macau a man suspected of involvement in a HK$10 million (US$1.29 million) robbery of a jetfoil ferry, the Macau Daily News said on Saturday.
Chan Kui Qing, 38, was arrested when he arrived in Portuguese-ruled Macau on Friday on a flight from Taiwan after his arrest and expulsion by Taiwan. He was charged with piracy.
Chan was suspected of having participated in the hijacking of a jetfoil on June 22, 1995, and the theft of HK$10 million which the ferry was transporting for a Macau bank.
Several members of the robbery gang have already been tried and jailed in Macau and Hong Kong, while others were caught in China and sentenced to death.
Authorities said Chan fled via Vietnam after the robbery and was arrested by Taiwan police this week.
